title: गीतको पहिचान तथा माधव घिमिरेको ‘नेपालै नरहे’ गीति कविता {Identification of song and Madhav Ghimire's lyrical poetry "Nepalai Narahe" }
nepali: प्रस्तुत लेख कवि तथा गीतकार माधव धिमिरे (१९७६—२०७७)का ‘किन्नरकिन्नरी’ गीत सङग्रहमा सङकलित गीतहरूमध्येएउटा गीत (गीति कविता) नेपाल नरहेसँग सम्बद्ध छ । यसलेख नपालै नरहे गीति कवितामा पाइने राष्टियताका भावनाका अध्ययनसंग सम्बन्धित छ । उक्त गीति कविता मुख्य गरी राष्ट र राष्ट्रियताको विषयवस्तुमा आधारित रहेकालेसोही अनुसार यस गीति कवितामा प्रयुक्त पद–पदावलीका व्याख्या र विश्लेषण गर्दै यस गीति कवितामा पाइने गीतकारकाराष्टियताप्रति रहेका भावनाका खोजी गरिएको छ । यहां  गीतमा प्रयुक्त पद तथा पदावलीहरूका विश्लेषण गर्दै भाषापरकअध्ययनलाई अध्ययनका सैद्धान्तिक आधार बनाई गीति कवितामा देशभक्तिको भावना कसरी व्यक्त भएको छ भन्नेआधारबाट अध्ययन गरिएको छ । मुख्य रूपले व्याख्या विश्लषणात्मक विधिबाट अध्ययन गरिएको यस लेखमा योकविता राष्टियताको भावनाले ओतप्रोत भएको गीति कविता हो भन्ने निष्कर्ष दिइएको छ । {The present article is related to one of the songs (lyric poetry) compiled in the song collection'Kinnarkinnari' by the poet and lyricist Madhav Ghimire (1976-2077). Therefore, this article isrelated to the study of the sense of nationalism found in Nepali lyrical poetry. As the lyric poemis mainly based on the theme of nation and nationality, the lyricist's sentiments towardsnationality are explored in this lyric poem by interpreting and analyzing the phrases used in thislyric poem. Here, by analyzing the terms and phrases used in the song, linguistic study has beenmade as the theoretical basis of the study and the study has been done on the basis of how thefeeling of patriotism has been expressed in this lyric poetry. In this article, which has beenstudied mainly through interpretive and analytical method, it has been concluded that this poemis a lyric poem full of nationalism.}
american_english: The present article is concerned with one song (lyric poem), "Nepal Narahe," among the songs compiled in the song collection "Kinnar-Kinnari" by poet and lyricist Madhav Ghimire (1976–2077 BS). This article is related to the study of the sentiments of nationalism found in the lyric poem "Nepalai Narahe." As this lyric poem is mainly based on the theme of nation and nationality, accordingly, by interpreting and analyzing the words and phrases used in this lyric poem, the lyricist's sentiments toward nationality found in this lyric poem have been explored. Here, analyzing the terms and phrases used in the song and making linguistic study the theoretical basis of the inquiry, the study has been conducted on the basis of how the feeling of patriotism is expressed in the lyric poem. In this article, studied mainly through an interpretative and analytical method, the conclusion is given that this poem is a lyric poem replete with the sentiment of nationalism.

informal_english: This article is about one song (lyric poem), "Nepal Narahe", among the songs collected in the song collection "Kinnar-Kinnari" by poet and songwriter Madhav Ghimire (1976–2077 BS). This article is concerned with studying the sense of nationalism found in the lyric poem "Nepalai Narahe". As this lyric poem is mainly based on the theme of nation and nationality, the songwriter's feelings about nationality in this lyric poem have been explored accordingly by unpacking and analysing the words and phrases used in the poem. Here, by analysing the terms and phrases used in the song and making linguistic study the theoretical basis of the inquiry, the study has been done on the basis of how patriotic feeling is expressed in the lyric poem. Researched mainly through an interpretive and analytical method, this paper wraps up with the conclusion that this poem is a lyric poem packed with the feeling of nationalism.
